### Fixed
- **`muster auth login` signs in again when the server rejects a stored token that has not expired.** A token file whose access token was unexpired by its stored expiry but rejected by the server (the server dropped the session) made the login print `Establishing SSO connections...` and exit 0 without a browser, a sign-in URL or a token, `--force` included, and `muster auth status` stayed `Not authenticated` until the stored expiry passed. The login now checks the session with the server after reusing the stored one and runs the browser (or `--no-browser`) flow when the server still answers 401; `--force` always runs the flow. The command exits 0 only once the server accepts the session, and with exit code 3 when a completed flow leaves none; `--server` and `--all` sign in to the aggregator the same way. ([#1484](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1484))
